annotations.title: Get the best months for padel

description: Rates each month for outdoor padel from climate averages: all day, morning or evening (midday too hot), midday (mornings and evenings cold), or cold or wet. Use it when someone asks when to go, or where to play in a given month. Give a country for its year and its regions', a month for every country that month, or both.

month.description: 1 for January to 12 for December. A month name works too.
